announcements.text: Black Construction Corp., Harmon, Guam, is awarded a $122,134,480 firm-fixed-price contract for the construction of a machine gun range at the Northwest Field, Andersen Air Force Base, Guam. The work also includes utilities, site work and incidental related work. The option, if exercised, provides for the furniture, fixtures, and equipment. The production shipsets consist of 140 Generation 3 configuration position sensor blocks for CVN 79 and CVN 80. Additionally, this effort updates the purchase cable drum (PCD) -05 configuration for CVN 79, and procures one PCD-07 configuration for CVN 80.
